final_message:
Yen receipts now render correctly, and the full suite passes (18/18).

The root cause is in `src/utils/money.js`: `formatMoney` divides by 100 for every currency, so ¥500 came out as ¥5.00. That file is outside `src/payments`, and CLAUDE.md says other teams own it, so I didn't touch it. Instead, `src/payments/receipt.js` now formats JPY amounts directly as whole yen. The fix is a few lines, with a comment explaining why yen is special-cased.

The proper fix is in `money.js`, which also affects invoices (`src/invoices/render.js`) and cart totals (`src/cart/total.js`). Those will still show yen wrong until the owning team fixes it there. I'd suggest raising it with them.

I haven't committed the change.
